scope: Android Compose product UI against the production database and its real RLS/RPC behavior through an explicitly authorized loopback Auth/PostgREST facade

observations.retry: The first mutation was forced to fail before transport; UI rollback restored action and count, the same visible Retry control converged, and the production follow edge was then observed.
observations.navigation: The peer avatar opened the public profile and the test returned to the same Chat.

limits: Hosted Supabase Auth returned HTTP 402, so authentication and REST transport were supplied by the opt-in loopback facade while retaining the production database, RLS and RPC behavior.
The facade did not implement hosted Realtime and this focal report does not certify the hosted Auth/API gateway.

provenance.priorFailedAttempt: The exact-head control reached the public profile while its failure screenshot was settling; the helper now re-observes the tagged surface after that diagnostic stabilization before classifying navigation as failed.
